aliases: スパティフィラム・ウォーリシー

light.best.quote: Peace lilies prefer partial to deep shade.

light.min.quote: Peace lilies prefer partial to deep shade.

light.directSun.quote: Do not place plants in direct sun.

temperature.minC.quote: Extended periods below 40 degrees F can damage leaves, stems and roots.

temperature.idealC.quote: They enjoy warm conditions between 68 and 85 degrees F during the day

humidity.quote: Brown leaf tips are caused by excessive direct sunlight, underwatering, or low humidity.

watering.growing.quote: Keep the soil moist, but not soggy; allow it to dry between waterings.

watering.winter.reason: 出典に冬の記載がないため、室温が下がると水を吸う量が減ることから一段乾かし気味とした

tips.ja: 4〜16℃（40〜60°F）の寒さやすきま風では成長がかなり遅くなる。
tips.quote: Cold and drafty conditions, specifically temperatures of 40 to 60 degrees F, will slow growth considerably.

tips.ja: 肥料は規定の1/4の濃さで。与えすぎると葉先や根が傷む。
tips.quote: Fertilize at one-quarter of the recommended strength

tips.ja: 鉢底から水を吸わせる「底面給水」がよく合う。
tips.quote: Watering from below works very well for peace lilies.
